title: Meta Touts AI Progress While Escalating Its Bet on the Market
description: Meta Platforms Inc. Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg told investors that a pricey wager on artificial intelligence is delivering results, setting the stage for the company to bet even more aggressively on the market.

title: Meta Offers Zuckerberg New Shares to Shield Him From Wealth Tax
description: Meta signed an agreement with Mark Zuckerberg to keep him living in the same jurisdiction as the company’s headquarters after the CEO said he was weighing leaving California if the state passes a wealth tax. Ed Ludlow has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Comcast Planning Significant Jobs Cuts as Part of Reorganization
description: Comcast Corp. is planning a significant number of job cuts as part of an overall restructuring of its cable-TV, broadband and wireless businesses, according to people familiar with the company’s thinking.
